Context Menu

Context menus appear at the pointer on right-click, listing actions relevant to the element under the cursor. Right-click any of the targets below.

Basic Context Menu

Mark a target with data-zak-contextmenu="#id". The menu is positioned at the cursor, clamped to the viewport, and closes on click, Escape or scroll.

Right-click anywhere here
HTML
<div class="ctx-target" data-zak-contextmenu="#cmBasic">Right-click anywhere here</div>

<div class="zak-context-menu" id="cmBasic">
    <button class="zak-menu-item">Rename</button>
    <button class="zak-menu-item">Duplicate</button>
    <button class="zak-menu-item">Copy link</button>
    <hr class="zak-menu-divider">
    <button class="zak-menu-item is-danger">Delete</button>
</div>

Context Menu with Icons

Pair items with inline SVG icons to speed up scanning. Keep icons consistent and muted.

Right-click the card

Context Menu with Divider

Use .zak-menu-divider to group destructive or low-frequency actions away from primary ones.

Disabled Items

.is-disabled renders non-interactive items for unavailable actions.

Right-click the message

Dynamic Label from Target

Show the actioned object in a header or mutate items before opening by listening to the zak:open event — e.g. “Rename Draft v3”.

Right-click “Draft v3”
Actions
HTML
var menu = document.getElementById('cmDynamic');
menu.addEventListener('zak:open', function () {
    document.getElementById('cmDynamicLabel').textContent = 'Actions for Draft v3';
});

CSS Classes & Variables

HTML
/* Class Summary */
.zak-context-menu             /* Floating menu, fixed at pointer */
.zak-context-menu-active      /* Added by JS to show */
.zak-menu-header              /* Group label */
.zak-menu-item                /* Row action */
.zak-menu-item.is-danger      /* Destructive action */
.zak-menu-item.is-disabled    /* Unavailable action */
.zak-menu-divider             /* Separator line */

/* Variables used */
--zak-surface                 /* Menu background */
--zak-border                  /* Menu border */
--zak-shadow-lg               /* Menu shadow */
--zak-z-context-menu          /* Above all other overlays */

JavaScript

HTML
// Data attributes (automatic)
//   data-zak-contextmenu="#id"    open menu at pointer on right-click

// Programmatic API
zak.contextMenu.open('#myMenu', { x: 120, y: 80 });
zak.contextMenu.close('#myMenu');

// Events on the menu element
menu.addEventListener('zak:open', function (e) {
    console.log(e.detail.x, e.detail.y);   // pointer position
});
menu.addEventListener('zak:close', function () {});
menu.addEventListener('zak:select', function (e) {
    console.log('Chose', e.detail.value);
});

// Global handlers are attached once; the nearest
// [data-zak-contextmenu] target wires automatically.

Accessibility

  • Context menus are discoverable from keyboard: focus a target and press Shift+F10 or the Menu key to open it.
  • The menu uses role="menu" with menuitem items; arrow keys move, Enter/Space selects, Escape closes.
  • Provide aria-haspopup="menu" on targets (applied automatically).
  • Never hide regular page controls behind right-click only — always mirror context menu actions in the UI.
  • The menu stays within the viewport; on small screens it clamps to the edges.
